# Secrets

The secrets interface is the same for every secrets service of Grow Codes. You get a
`SecretsProvider` from the __DISPLAY__ client (see [Functions](functions.md) for the accessor and
for service options such as mounts, paths or projects); the examples below call it `secrets`.

Secret values come back as `SecretValue`, a redacting wrapper: printing or serialising it shows
`SecretValue([REDACTED])`. Read the content explicitly with `reveal()` (text), `revealBytes()` or
`json()`.

## Functions

| Function | Returns | Notes |
| - | - | - |
| `get(name, opts?)` | `SecretValue` or null | `opts`: `version`, `path` |
| `getString(name)` / `getJson(name)` | text / decoded JSON or null | `VALIDATION` for non-UTF-8 or non-JSON |
| `getNumber(name)` / `getBool(name)` | number / boolean or null | booleans: `true/false/1/0/yes/no/on/off` |
| `require(name)` | `SecretValue` | `NOT_FOUND` when missing |
| `exists(name)` | boolean | |
| `getMany(names)` | map name → value | missing names omitted, request order kept |
| `getAll(path?)` | map name → value | every secret directly under `path` (non-recursive) |
| `list(prefixOrPath?)` | `SecretMetadata[]` sorted by name | names and metadata, no values |
| `set(name, value, opts?)` | new version (`""` without versions) | value: text, bytes or an object (JSON-encoded); `opts`: `path`, `cas`, `tags`, `description` |
| `delete(name, opts?)` | — | `NOT_FOUND` when missing; `opts`: `path`, `versions`, `permanent` |
| `metadata(name)` | `SecretMetadata` or null | `name, path, version, createdAt, updatedAt, tags, versions, extra` |
| `loadEnv(pathOrMapping, opts?)` | variables set (names only) | `opts`: `override` (default false), `prefix` |
| `watch(name, interval, onChange, opts?)` | `WatchHandle` (`stop()`) | polls; `onChange(newValue, oldValue)`, deletion → `newValue = null` |

## Read secrets

=== "TypeScript"

    ```ts
    const dbPassword = await secrets.require("db-password");
    connect({ password: dbPassword.reveal() });

    const apiUrl = await secrets.getString("api-url");             // string | null
    const limits = await secrets.getJson<{ rps: number }>("limits"); // object | null
    const debug = (await secrets.getBool("debug")) ?? false;
    const many = await secrets.getMany(["a", "b", "missing"]);     // Map with a, b
    const all = await secrets.getAll("app/prod");
    const old = await secrets.get("db-password", { version: "3" });
    console.log(String(dbPassword)); // SecretValue([REDACTED])
    ```

=== "Rust"

    ```rust
    use grow___KEY_SNAKE__::secrets::{GetOptions, SecretsProvider};

    let db_password = secrets.require("db-password", None).await?;
    connect(db_password.reveal()?);

    let api_url: Option<String> = secrets.get_string("api-url", None).await?;
    let debug = secrets.get_bool("debug", None).await?.unwrap_or(false);
    let many = secrets.get_many(&["a", "b", "missing"], None).await?;
    let all = secrets.get_all(Some("app/prod")).await?;
    let old = secrets
        .get("db-password", Some(&GetOptions { version: Some("3".into()), ..Default::default() }))
        .await?;
    println!("{db_password:?}"); // SecretValue([REDACTED])
    ```

=== "Go"

    ```go
    dbPassword, err := secrets.Require(ctx, "db-password", nil)
    if err != nil {
        return err // errors.Is(err, __PKG__.ErrNotFound) when missing
    }
    connect(dbPassword.Reveal())

    apiURL, ok, err := secrets.GetString(ctx, "api-url", nil)
    var limits struct{ RPS int }
    found, err := secrets.GetJSON(ctx, "limits", &limits, nil)
    debug, _, err := secrets.GetBool(ctx, "debug", nil)
    many, err := secrets.GetMany(ctx, []string{"a", "b", "missing"}, nil)
    all, err := secrets.GetAll(ctx, "app/prod")
    old, err := secrets.Get(ctx, "db-password", &__PKG__.GetOptions{Version: "3"})
    fmt.Println(dbPassword) // SecretValue([REDACTED])
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    db_password = secrets.require("db-password")
    connect(password=db_password.reveal())

    api_url = secrets.get_string("api-url")          # str | None
    limits = secrets.get_json("limits")              # Any | None
    debug = secrets.get_bool("debug") or False
    many = secrets.get_many(["a", "b", "missing"])   # dict with a, b
    everything = secrets.get_all("app/prod")
    old = secrets.get("db-password", version="3")
    print(db_password)  # SecretValue([REDACTED])
    ```

=== "Java"

    ```java
    SecretValue dbPassword = secrets.require("db-password");
    connect(dbPassword.reveal());

    Optional<String> apiUrl = secrets.getString("api-url");
    Optional<Limits> limits = secrets.getJson("limits", Limits.class);
    boolean debug = secrets.getBool("debug").orElse(false);
    Map<String, SecretValue> many = secrets.getMany(List.of("a", "b", "missing"));
    Map<String, SecretValue> all = secrets.getAll("app/prod");
    System.out.println(dbPassword); // SecretValue([REDACTED])
    ```

    Every method also has an `…Async` variant returning `CompletableFuture`.

## Write, list and delete

=== "TypeScript"

    ```ts
    const version = await secrets.set("api-key", "s3cr3t", { tags: { team: "payments" } });
    await secrets.set("limits", { rps: 50 });              // JSON-encoded
    await secrets.set("api-key", "rotated", { cas: 1 });   // CONFLICT if the version moved
    for (const meta of await secrets.list("app/")) console.log(meta.name, meta.version);
    const meta = await secrets.metadata("api-key");
    await secrets.delete("api-key");
    ```

=== "Rust"

    ```rust
    use grow___KEY_SNAKE__::secrets::SecretData;

    let version = secrets.set("api-key", SecretData::Text("s3cr3t".into()), None).await?;
    secrets.set("limits", SecretData::Json(serde_json::json!({"rps": 50})), None).await?;
    for meta in secrets.list(Some("app/")).await? {
        println!("{} {:?}", meta.name, meta.version);
    }
    let meta = secrets.metadata("api-key", None).await?;
    secrets.delete("api-key", None).await?;
    ```

=== "Go"

    ```go
    version, err := secrets.Set(ctx, "api-key", "s3cr3t", &__PKG__.SetOptions{Tags: map[string]string{"team": "payments"}})
    _, err = secrets.Set(ctx, "limits", map[string]int{"rps": 50}, nil) // JSON-encoded
    list, err := secrets.List(ctx, "app/")
    meta, err := secrets.Metadata(ctx, "api-key", nil)
    err = secrets.Delete(ctx, "api-key", nil)
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    version = secrets.set("api-key", "s3cr3t", tags={"team": "payments"})
    secrets.set("limits", {"rps": 50})               # JSON-encoded
    for meta in secrets.list("app/"):
        print(meta.name, meta.version)
    meta = secrets.metadata("api-key")
    secrets.delete("api-key")
    ```

=== "Java"

    ```java
    String version = secrets.set("api-key", "s3cr3t", SetOptions.none());
    secrets.set("limits", Map.of("rps", 50), SetOptions.none()); // JSON-encoded
    for (SecretMetadata meta : secrets.list("app/")) {
      System.out.println(meta.name() + " " + meta.version());
    }
    secrets.delete("api-key", DeleteOptions.none());
    ```

## Load secrets into the environment

`loadEnv(path)` sets one variable per secret directly under `path`: the name is upper-cased and
every character outside `[A-Z0-9_]` becomes `_` (`db-password` → `DB_PASSWORD`), prefixed with
`prefix`. `loadEnv(mapping)` sets each variable from the named secret (`NOT_FOUND` when one is
missing). Existing variables are kept unless `override` is true. The result lists the variables
that were set — never the values.

=== "TypeScript"

    ```ts
    await secrets.loadEnv("app/prod", { prefix: "APP_" });       // process.env.APP_DB_PASSWORD
    await secrets.loadEnv({ DATABASE_URL: "db-url" }, { override: true });
    ```

=== "Rust"

    ```rust
    use grow___KEY_SNAKE__::secrets::{EnvSource, LoadEnvOptions};

    let set = secrets
        .load_env(&EnvSource::Path("app/prod".into()), &LoadEnvOptions { prefix: "APP_".into(), ..Default::default() })
        .await?;
    ```

=== "Go"

    ```go
    set, err := secrets.LoadEnv(ctx, "app/prod", &__PKG__.LoadEnvOptions{Prefix: "APP_"})
    set, err = secrets.LoadEnvMapping(ctx, map[string]string{"DATABASE_URL": "db-url"}, &__PKG__.LoadEnvOptions{Override: true})
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    secrets.load_env("app/prod", prefix="APP_")                 # os.environ["APP_DB_PASSWORD"]
    secrets.load_env({"DATABASE_URL": "db-url"}, override=True)
    ```

=== "Java"

    Java cannot change the process environment, so `loadEnv` sets **system properties** and
    returns the names it set.

    ```java
    Map<String, String> set = secrets.loadEnv("app/prod", LoadEnvOptions.builder().prefix("APP_").build());
    String dbPassword = System.getProperty("APP_DB_PASSWORD");
    ```

## Watch for changes

`watch` polls every interval and compares the version (or a SHA-256 of the value when the service
has no versions). Errors go to `onError` and polling continues. `stop()` is idempotent and closing
the client stops every watcher.

=== "TypeScript"

    ```ts
    const handle = secrets.watch("api-key", 30_000, (next, prev) => rotate(next?.reveal()), {
      onError: (err) => console.warn(err.message),
    });
    handle.stop();
    ```

=== "Rust"

    ```rust
    use grow___KEY_SNAKE__::secrets::{watch, WatchOptions};

    let handle = watch(Arc::new(secrets), "api-key", Duration::from_secs(30),
        |next, _prev| rotate(next), WatchOptions::default());
    handle.stop();
    ```

=== "Go"

    ```go
    handle := secrets.Watch(ctx, "api-key", 30*time.Second, func(next, prev *__PKG__.SecretValue) {
        rotate(next)
    }, &__PKG__.WatchOptions{OnError: func(err error) { log.Print(err) }})
    defer handle.Stop()
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    handle = secrets.watch("api-key", 30.0, lambda new, old: rotate(new), on_error=print)
    handle.stop()
    ```

=== "Java"

    ```java
    WatchHandle handle = secrets.watch("api-key", Duration.ofSeconds(30),
        (next, prev) -> rotate(next), WatchOptions.none());
    handle.stop();
    ```

## Cache

`SecretCache` wraps a provider and caches reads (`get*`, `require`, `exists`, `getMany`) with LRU
eviction; writes pass through and invalidate. Missing secrets are cached too.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
| - | - | - |
| `ttl` | 60 s | lifetime of an entry |
| `maxEntries` | 1000 | LRU capacity |
| `refreshAheadFactor` | 0.8 | a hit after `ttl × factor` starts one background refresh |
| `staleWhileRevalidate` | 0 | within `ttl + staleWhileRevalidate` a stale value is returned while one refresh runs |
| `clock` | system | injectable for tests |

`invalidate(name)`, `clear()` and `stats()` (`hits, misses, evictions, refreshes, size`) are
available in every language.

=== "TypeScript"

    ```ts
    import { SecretCache } from "@grow-codes/__KEY__";

    const cached = new SecretCache(secrets, { ttlMs: 300_000, staleWhileRevalidateMs: 30_000 });
    const key = await cached.require("api-key");
    console.log(cached.stats());
    ```

=== "Rust"

    ```rust
    use grow___KEY_SNAKE__::secrets::{SecretCache, SecretCacheOptions};

    let cached = SecretCache::with_options(
        Arc::new(secrets),
        SecretCacheOptions { ttl: Duration::from_secs(300), ..Default::default() },
    );
    let key = cached.require("api-key", None).await?;
    ```

=== "Go"

    ```go
    cached := __PKG__.NewSecretCache(secrets, &__PKG__.CacheOptions{TTL: 5 * time.Minute})
    key, err := cached.Require(ctx, "api-key", nil)
    fmt.Printf("%+v\n", cached.Stats())
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    from grow___KEY_SNAKE__ import SecretCache

    cached = SecretCache(secrets, ttl_s=300.0, stale_while_revalidate_s=30.0)
    key = cached.require("api-key")
    print(cached.stats())
    ```

=== "Java"

    ```java
    SecretCache cached = new SecretCache(secrets,
        SecretCache.Options.builder().ttl(Duration.ofMinutes(5)).build());
    SecretValue key = cached.require("api-key");
    ```

## Testing

The testing module (see [Docker testing](docker-testing.md#test-fakes-for-your-own-tests)) has an
in-memory `SecretsProvider` with the same behaviour, so application tests run without the service.
